explanation: It is so remote that space agencies have steered old spacecraft to fall into the sea nearby, far from shipping lanes and people.

claims.text: Point Nemo, the oceanic pole of inaccessibility, lies in the South Pacific Ocean.
Point Nemo is not in the North Pacific, the South Atlantic or the Indian Ocean.
Point Nemo is the point in the ocean furthest from any land.
Space agencies have steered spacecraft at the end of their missions to fall into the ocean near Point Nemo.
